newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal cracks down on illegal foreign workers.
newsitem.headline: Portugal cracks down on illegal foreign workers.

text.p: The Portuguese government on Thursday approved a bill to fine companies who employ foreign workers illegally.
In future companies will have to register contracts signed with foreigners with work inspection and immigration authorities, the cabinet said in a statement.
Failure to do so will result in fines of up to 500,000 escudos ($2,950) per worker.

"The aim of this bill is to combat illegal work by foreigners which has harmed both foreign and Portuguese workers because of the abuses of salaries and workers' rights which occur when employees are illegal," the statement said.
Large numbers of illegal immigrants, many of them from Portugal's former African colonies, work for wages below the minimum legal rate. ($ = 169.59 escudos)
